SUFFICIENT AMOUNT OF ELECTROLYTE TO BE PROVIDED IN THE FORM OF 3-4 EXTRA REFILLS OR MORE 10. PROCEDURE FOR OPERATING THE INSTRUMENT AS WELL AS CALIBRATION SHOULD BE CLEARLY ILLUSTRATED IN THE MANUAL" Special Terms and Conditions for bidders :- a) The vendor has to submit the Catalogue, make & model of quoted instrument with complete specificatio ns at the time of bidding itself and same will be freezed for technical evaluation and it can not be changed later on. Any deviation from product specifications and ATC result in technically non acceptability/rejection

b) In addition to above, vendor will install commission and demo the instruments (same make and model as quoted in the bid) free of cost after delivery at site. Supply of different instrument /make model will res ult in action as per GeM GTC. c) Contract Period: 01 year d) Delivery Period: Within Two months from the issuing date of GeM order. e) Guarantee / Warrantee: Minimum 1 Year f) PBG: Applicable , e-PBG @ 5% with validity of 14 months g) Penalty: Applicable as per NIT. h) Test certificate from the manufacturer is required. i) QVC and Qty tolerance : Not applicable (j) SD clause not applicable (k) Interchangeability : Not applicable (l) Sellers/Bidders are advised not to participate in the bid from the same IP addresses. The bid/offer of tho se firms will liable to be rejected, if it is observed/noticed that bidders have participated from the same IP address of two or more firms. (j) The vendor has to upload the complete manual of offered product to crossche ck the specifications, failing which the bid will not be considered .
